problem: Heterogeneous languages, runtimes, proof systems, hardware descriptions, and agent interfaces must compose without semantic drift, evidence inflation, duplicated responsibility, or authority leaking across system boundaries.
unique_value: The Tower provides governed semantic interoperability: each technology keeps a bounded native responsibility while canonical contracts, executable gates, exact blockers, and deterministic receipts make cross-language composition inspectable and truth-preserving.
success_condition: A mission can cross technology boundaries without changing its governed meaning, and every promoted capability can be traced to revision-bound local proof plus authority that the subject repository did not grant to itself.
